text: {me} of {me.house} storms into the hall: "{suitor} of {rival.house} took my daughter {daughter} off the road at night. Forty riders, no banners. I want her back, and I want his head."
{me} of {me.house} bursts into the hall: "{suitor} of {rival.house} dragged my daughter {daughter} off the road by night. Forty riders, no banners. Bring her home, and bring me his head."

{me} of {me.house} comes through the doors in a rage: "Last night {suitor} of {rival.house} seized my daughter {daughter} on the road, with forty riders and no banners. I want her returned, and I want his head with her."

options.label: They're married. Make it lawful

memory.me: The King blessed the man who stole my daughter.

options.label: Let {me.house} take her back by force

{me.house} hears the King's ruling and sends riders to every holdfast. A {me.father} may take back {me.his} daughter, and means to.
{heir}, heir of {me.house}, has run off with a girl of {rival.house}. {me} wants the King's men to bring the young fool home. {rival} says {rival.his} house has been shamed, and wants blood.
{heir}, heir of {me.house}, has slipped away with a girl of {rival.house}. {me} asks the King's men to fetch the runaway home. {rival} says {rival.his} house is shamed and calls for blood.

options.label: Bring {heir} home in chains

memory.heir: The King dragged me home in chains.

options.label: Let them be together

options.label: Pay {rival.house} for the insult (120 gold)

{rival.house} accepts the crown's purse for its daughter. Settled, says the treaty. The houses have not read it.

Word from your spymaster: {bannerman}, sworn to {me.house}, sat in a border inn with men wearing {rival.house}'s colours, and coin passed hands. {me} knows nothing of it yet.
Your spymaster reports that {bannerman}, a sworn man of {me.house}, met men in {rival.house}'s colours at an inn on the border. Silver changed hands. {me} has not heard.

options.label: Tell {me}

options.label: Make {bannerman} the crown's spy (80 gold)
options.hint: You'll know what {rival.house} plans, but if it comes out, both houses will hate you

memory.bannerman: I serve the King now, whoever else I smile at.

text: The King watches. {bannerman} rides home to {me.house}, smiling.

options.label: Bless the alliance in public

options.label: Send the letter on to {rival.house}

{me} of {me.house} begs the King's leave to march on {rivalTown}: "{rival} is burning my villages and laughing at your peace. Give me leave to march, or give me justice."
{me} of {me.house} comes before the King to ask leave to attack {rivalTown}: "{rival} puts my villages to the torch and mocks your peace. Let me ride, or see me righted."

options.label: Let them march

{bannerman} of {me.house} died on a hunt in {rival.house}'s woods with an arrow in the back. {rival}'s men call it a stray shot. {me} calls it murder.
